assumptions.description: Provider-recorded completed US reverse splits; dated events from 2023 onward. Discovery coverage is incomplete and cancelled/non-completed announcements are not a complete population.
At least the second documented split for the same SEC issuer, using distinct prior effective dates and source availability before entry. This is a lower bound on lifetime splits.

Original source-bound distress score ≥60; higher means greater deterioration. At least three measured score signals, every filing available before entry and period age ≤200 days. Unknown or stale scores exclude entry. It is not a probability or full underwriting.
No mandatory rally veto, cash-burn, runway, operating-loss or dilution condition. No score-based size multiplier.

Filing date plus one Eastern calendar day, then first 09:30 exchange open later than availability plus five minutes and strictly before the effective split date. Exact press-release timestamps are unavailable.

Five exchange sessions including entry is the selected default; planned cover is at the fifth session close. Ten and twenty sessions are explicit comparisons. Delayed and partial covers remain liabilities.
No price stop and no profit target. A time exit is not a loss limit. Stops tested elsewhere did not clear the validation requirements.

$25,000 reference short notional per event, rounded down to whole entry shares. Full-size mode removes account and volume admission caps while retaining one open position per issuer and strict SSR checks. These are hypothetical fills, not demonstrated capacity.

$1m hypothetical reference equity; 1% of prior 20-session split-adjusted share ADV and recorded same-day volume; three-name cap. Per-name +200% squeeze reserve implies roughly 0.25% equity notional; joint reserve, low-price margin floors and 20% headroom also bind. Tiny unresolved remnants can occupy slots. Same-day volume is a conditional execution proxy, not pre-entry knowledge.

Per nominal share, the frozen replay reserves max(price, max($2.50, price)) below $5 and max(price, $5, 30% of price) at or above $5. Multiply by remaining nominal shares, then sum positions. Very low pre-split prices can therefore require many times short notional. This is the inherited research reserve, not verified broker margin. The funded-performance diagnostic requires the peak to stay at or below $800,000 against the $1m reference.
Restricted or unknown SSR entries are excluded. An unrestricted historical status still does not prove an approved locate or actual fill.

Cached official opening and closing references with nominal share quantities. Mechanical split factors adjust quantity and price inversely; a split itself creates no P&L. Per-trade marks are derived ledger entries, not executable quotes.
Lower: 1% round trip; base: 1.72%; stress: 4.25%. Half applies to entry, half to each cover reference. No actual routing, NBBO queue or fill evidence is available.

Lower/base/stress APR 20%/50%/150%, ACT/360 on nominal shares × ceil(102% × prior closing nominal price), across modeled settled calendar days; at least one billed day. These are sensitivities, not historical loan invoices.

Inherited exchange-session settlement proxy: T+2 before 2024-05-28, T+1 thereafter. Calendar-day accrual includes weekends. Bank-only settlement holiday and actual loan-return differences require reconciliation.

Per modeled execution: min(max($0.005/share, $1), 1% of execution value), plus the dated SEC Section 31 and FINRA TAF schedules and the inherited per-share allowance. Every child cover is charged separately.

Full-size mode assumes adjusted fractional liabilities can be covered at the modeled cover price. Actual fractional cash settlement is unverified. Constrained mode requires whole nominal cover shares and retains remnants with ongoing costs; it never silently deletes them.

After a gap of more than seven calendar days, security continuity is unresolved and later ticker prints are not automatically trusted. Admitted obligations remain marked. No future price availability is an entry filter.
All 5/10/20-session comparisons use the common final-20-session entry exclusion anchored to the original post-split entry. This avoids choosing eligibility based on eventual exits.
Actual locate charges, recalls, forced buy-ins, dividends, corporate-action cash adjustments, proceeds interest, taxes and operating overhead are not fully observed and are omitted.

Dollar marked P&L and daily closing drawdown include idle sessions and retained liabilities. Sharpe uses modeled daily P&L with zero cash benchmark; it is conditional historical research. Any CAGR/Calmar refers to the stated $1m reference, not an actual account, and is suppressed on unresolved/breached paths. Intraday drawdown is unobserved.

Previously explored history. Twenty issuers in the default case is below the 30-issuer research gate. No independent forward validation, actual locate approval or broker fill is asserted. No capital or execution authority is granted.

score_method.basis: Inherited as-filed annual or matched fiscal YTD score; at least three available signals.
score_method.formula: Round to one decimal: 100 × sum(available signal weight × clipped signal score) / sum(available weights). Each signal ramps linearly between its zero and full threshold and is clipped to [0,1]. Missing signals are omitted, never scored as zero.

signals.name: Accrual ratio
signals.definition: (Trailing net income − trailing operating cash flow) / total assets

signals.name: Profit without cash
signals.definition: 1 − operating cash flow / net income; only when net income is positive

signals.name: Cash burn
signals.definition: Cash / absolute trailing operating cash burn; only when operating cash flow is negative

signals.name: Margin trend
signals.definition: Trailing operating margin − year-ago trailing operating margin

score_method.leverage_adjustments: Add 0.5 to the leverage signal, capped at 1, when operating income is negative and debt is positive. Set it to 1 when reported equity is negative. Unreported current debt is treated as zero in the inherited calculation.
score_method.limitations: The frozen event cache retained the aggregate score and source observations, but not all component scores, exact signal counts or flow-period starts. This dashboard does not claim a complete per-component reconstruction. The cached score applies no industry-specific underwriting adjustment; a score of 60 is not a 60% probability.

metric_definitions.price_asof: Last date in the cached price panel.
metric_definitions.entered: All admitted positions, including unresolved positions.
metric_definitions.issuers: Distinct SEC issuers among admitted positions.
metric_definitions.closed: Positions with no material remaining share liability.
metric_definitions.net_pnl: Sum of every trade cash balance less any remaining marked cover liability.
metric_definitions.gross_pnl: Price P&L before execution debit, commissions, regulatory fees and borrow.
metric_definitions.borrow_cost: Total modeled loan carrying charges, including calendar days and settlement tails.
metric_definitions.commissions_and_fees: Total commissions, SEC sale fees, FINRA TAF and per-share allowance.
metric_definitions.execution_cost: Difference between modeled fills and opening/closing price references.
metric_definitions.settlement_tail_accrual: Borrow after the final observed price date, charged through modeled loan return.
metric_definitions.mean_net_return: Equal-weight mean of trade net P&L / entry reference notional; includes marked unresolved trades.
metric_definitions.median_net_return: Median of trade net P&L / entry reference notional.
metric_definitions.win_rate_closed: Fraction of modeled closed trades with positive net P&L.
metric_definitions.profit_factor_closed: Sum of positive closed-trade P&L / absolute sum of negative closed-trade P&L.
metric_definitions.max_drawdown_dollars: Most negative session-close P&L decline from the earlier closing peak; zero is the initial peak.
metric_definitions.worst_day: Lowest session change in marked account P&L.
metric_definitions.best_day: Highest session change in marked account P&L.
metric_definitions.worst_trade: Lowest final marked trade P&L, including open liabilities.
metric_definitions.best_trade: Highest final marked trade P&L, including open liabilities.
metric_definitions.risk_breach_sessions: Constrained replay sessions violating its modeled risk or margin tests; raw mode does not enforce those admission limits.
metric_definitions.peak_exposure: Highest session-close marked remaining short notional.
metric_definitions.peak_margin: Highest session-close modeled margin under the declared low-price floor.
metric_definitions.peak_open_names: Highest session-close count of open positions.
metric_definitions.nav_for_200pct_squeeze_at_2pct_loss_budg: Illustrative capital = 200% × peak exposure / 2%. This is a squeeze reserve calculation, not observed account capital.
metric_definitions.open_positions: Positions retaining material share liabilities at the final mark.
metric_definitions.open_liability: Cost of remaining shares at the last trusted modeled mark.
metric_definitions.stale_sessions: Sessions with stale marked liabilities in the replay.
metric_definitions.overdue_positions: Positions that encountered missing, delayed or partial planned covers.
metric_definitions.fractional_residuals: Final positions with a nonzero remaining nominal quantity smaller than one share; includes numerical dust.
metric_definitions.action_conflicts: Positions flagged with an unresolved split-factor conflict.
metric_definitions.identity_unresolved: Positions for which a price gap makes security continuity unresolved.
metric_definitions.mean_monthly_since_first_entry: Average monthly marked P&L from the first entry; idle months are retained.
metric_definitions.median_month: Median monthly marked P&L from the first entry.
metric_definitions.positive_months: Months with strictly positive marked P&L from the first entry.
metric_definitions.total_months: Number of months from the first entry, including idle months.
metric_definitions.best_month: Highest monthly marked P&L from the first entry.
metric_definitions.worst_month: Lowest monthly marked P&L from the first entry.
metric_definitions.annualized_pnl: Net dollars divided by elapsed years from the first entry; this is not a compounded account return.
metric_definitions.trades_per_year: Admitted trades divided by elapsed years from the first entry.
metric_definitions.pooled_net_return: Total net P&L / sum of entry reference notionals; repeated use of capital is included in the denominator.
metric_definitions.issuer_bootstrap_mean_trade_return_95: Issuer-cluster bootstrap interval; not computed in this compact scenario export.
metric_definitions.top5_issuer_profit_share: Net contribution of the best five issuers / total net P&L; can exceed 100% when other issuers lose.
metric_definitions.pnl_without_best_issuer: Retrospectively subtract the best issuer contribution, without reallocating freed capacity.
metric_definitions.pnl_without_best5_issuers: Retrospectively subtract the best five issuer contributions, without reallocating freed capacity.
metric_definitions.broker_verified_entries: Entries supported by actual broker-fill evidence; none in this research.
metric_definitions.borrow_availability_verified: Whether historical approved locates are verified; false for this research.
metric_definitions.account_capital_limit_applied: Whether the $1m account and squeeze/margin admission limits were applied.
metric_definitions.negative_marked_trades: Positions with negative final marked net P&L.
metric_definitions.closed_trade_pnl: Net P&L of positions modeled closed.
metric_definitions.open_trade_marked_pnl: Net marked P&L of unresolved positions, including their retained liabilities.
metric_definitions.full_target_entries: Entries reaching at least 95% of their target notional.
metric_definitions.monthly_block_bootstrap_95: Six-month-block interval; not computed in this compact scenario export.
metric_definitions.break_even_borrow_apr: APR that would consume pre-borrow profit if trades, collateral paths and execution costs stayed unchanged. This is a sensitivity, not an achievable loan quote.
metric_definitions.common_mean_monthly: Mean monthly marked P&L over the common January 2023 onward comparison window, including idle months.
metric_definitions.common_window_first: First session in the common comparison window.
metric_definitions.worst_adverse_price_return: Largest observed daily high / split-adjusted entry reference price − 1 across admitted trades; executable intraday risk is unverified.
metric_definitions.conditional_daily_sharpe: Mean daily dollar P&L / population standard deviation × √252 on the common session calendar; zero cash benchmark, conditional fills.
metric_definitions.conditional_sortino: Mean daily dollar P&L / root-mean-square negative daily P&L × √252 on the common session calendar.
metric_definitions.daily_es95_dollars: Negative mean of daily P&L observations at or below the empirical fifth percentile; closing observations only.
metric_definitions.conditional_profit_to_drawdown: Net P&L / absolute maximum closing drawdown; not Calmar.
metric_definitions.funded_performance_valid: Requires no open positions, identity/action conflicts or risk breaches; peak modeled margin ≤$800k and every $1m-reference equity mark positive. Passing does not validate locates or fills.
metric_definitions.cagr: Compounded annual growth on the $1m reference over the common window; withheld unless the funding checks pass.
metric_definitions.calmar: Reference CAGR / absolute drawdown as a fraction of $1m; withheld unless the funding checks pass.
metric_definitions.mean_raw_target: Average intended notional before share rounding and constraints.
metric_definitions.entry_dollars: Sum of entry reference notionals, including reused capital.
metric_definitions.boosted_entries: Entries with a target greater than $25,000; zero for this strategy.
metric_definitions.score_known_entries: Admitted entries with an available point-in-time score.
metric_definitions.fractional_cover_assumptions: Trades requiring at least one non-integer adjusted cover in the full-size model.
metric_definitions.mean_trade_net_pnl: Arithmetic mean net marked P&L per admitted trade.
metric_definitions.median_trade_net_pnl: Median net marked P&L per admitted trade.
metric_definitions.average_winner: Average P&L among positive marked trades.
metric_definitions.average_loser: Average P&L among negative marked trades.
metric_definitions.breakeven_trades: Trades with exactly zero final marked P&L.
metric_definitions.exposure_weighted_net_return: Total net P&L / total entry reference dollars; equals pooled net return.

fee_schedule.SEC_rate_units: Dollars per $1 million of sale value, rate selected by modeled sale settlement date
fee_schedule.TAF_basis: Sale-side charge selected by trade date; per-execution share cap
fee_schedule.rounding: Round total fee upward to the next cent, per modeled execution
fee_schedule.source: Inherited frozen replay fee schedule; research assumptions
